verdict.rationale: Mercury is a banking/fintech service. In MCP terms it is a tool provider, not an agent host that consumes external MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only Mercury's own official MCP server (mcp.mercury.com), which is the opposite, server-side role and does not count toward this client story. Nothing indicates Mercury lets users plug third-party MCP servers into its product.
